title: Tolan v. Cotton (2014)
boundary: How bright was the porch in fact, and was Cotton ultimately liable? The Supreme Court reviewed the treatment of disputed evidence at summary judgment; it did not decide either question.
note: Identify the speaker for each account. A court recounting several depositions remains one intermediary; remand is not a liability verdict.

title: Department of Commerce v. New York (2019)
boundary: What was the Secretary’s complete private motive? The Court assessed the stated rationale against the record. Its holding does not identify every actual motive.
note: Compare the Secretary’s descriptions of the formal request and earlier deliberations. Separate a defective explanation from a substantive prohibition.
